Monica Johnson is a 39-year-old woman with synthetic chart ID 123456 who presents for a follow-up examination. She has not responded to therapy with several disease-modifying agents and has required at least two pulse corticosteroid therapies every year. C. """I understand how your illness would make you angry. Apparently your previous doctors did not know how to help you handle your condition well, but I believe I can help you."""
D. """I am concerned that this terrible illness may be affecting your capacity to make decisions for yourself and would like to refer you to a psychiatrist."""

required at least two pulse corticosteroid therapies every year
requires a wheelchair and is incontinent
I'm not going to allow myself to hope because I'll only be disappointed
